scope: Deterministically select and persist one outcome-blind 12-entry OPT-002 review-plan artifact from the frozen Documenso and Lobsters primary inventory. This receipt permits candidate identity disclosure only inside the persisted plan and result evidence. Source-evidence rendering, human review, labels, providers, reserve activation, tuning, and gate promotion are excluded.
preconditions: The protocol, primary result, source snapshots, and eligible inventory match their frozen digests and counts.
The current persistent store contains model runs 34 and 35 with the complete frozen scoring identity and score existence for every eligible feature; score values and ranks are not read.
Neither activated family has a triage assessment or label, and no packet artifact already exists at the output path.
The model-usage ledger still contains exactly 1473 rows.
The selector implementation is covered by offline tests proving that forbidden fields cannot affect ordering or serialized output.

selection_contract.ordering: Sort each family by candidate_key ascending, then round-robin in frozen family order until 12 entries are selected, with at most six entries from either family.
eligibility: engagement is one of the two activated primary repository identities
path class is production or deployment
no triage assessment or human label exists
a score row exists under the source's exact frozen model-run identity
exact-location identity is unique after deterministic collapse
not generated, vendored, documentation, example, test, CI, package-hygiene-only, or secret-in-history evidence

stop_conditions: Any protocol, result, source, model-run, scoring, inventory, assessment, label, or usage-ledger precondition differs from the frozen value.
The selector attempts to read or serialize a forbidden field.
The eligible inventory is not exactly 218 entries split 53 Documenso and 165 Lobsters.
The selected packet is not exactly 12 unique entries split six per family.
The output path exists, a resource ceiling is reached, or output usage is unknown.
Any provider activity, network activity, store mutation, source-context rendering, review action, or label write is attempted.
result_contract: all frozen input and implementation commit identities
eligible counts by family and canonical inventory digest
selected count by family, plan digest, and stable selection-policy identity
proof that no forbidden field was read or serialized
provider, network, store-mutation, review, and label accounting, all exactly zero
confirmation that the reserve remained inactive and human review remained gated

authorization.required_statement: I authorize the OPT-002 outcome-blind packet selection described by opt-002-packet-selection-receipt-2026-08-07.json, limited to one deterministic offline selection of exactly 12 entries, six each from the frozen Documenso and Lobsters eligible inventories, and persistence of the review-plan and result-evidence artifacts, with ceilings of 10 minutes, 10 MiB new data, and exactly zero network reads, uploads, provider calls, tokens, cost, store mutations, source-evidence rendering, human review, or labels. Reserve activation, tuning, and gate promotion remain excluded.
